control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM advisory - SLP-CLASS-B barrier fluid support system

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 March 2020 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting P-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
